definition.note: No closed form is stored: the surface is not implemented in math_art, so there is no shipped code to verify a transcription against, and an unverified formula from the literature would be worse than a null. See construction.blocked_by.

construction.blocked_by: Schoen starfish surface with no datafile. Brakke's starfish page shows it, but publishes datafiles for only eight of the sixteen (genus 31, 43, 47, 55, 59, 63, 75, 87) -- those eight ship. There is no .fe for this one in the mirror or in starfish.tar, so it cannot be built or checked against Evolver.
